title: Effect of Oxygen on the Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Ti1.5ZrNbMoV Refractory High-Entropy Alloy
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting in a water-cooled copper crucible under a Ti-getter Ar atmosphere with six remelting cycles, followed by suction casting into a copper mold to produce rod specimens
